title: Augmenting Large Audio-Language Models with Frame-Level Grounding for Fine-Grained Temporal Perception
abstract: arXiv:2609.15215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have substantially advanced general audio understanding, yet they remain limited in fine-grained temporal perception, particularly in precise event localization. Existing approaches primarily post-train LALMs to predict event boundaries as timestamp tokens. However, this generative formulation lacks explicit correspondence between the timestamp predictions and fine-grained acoustic evidence, limiting the precision and reliability of temporal localization. To address this issue, we augment the LALM with a dedicated frame-level grounding model while leveraging its semantic modeling capability to represent the event query. Specifically, the frozen LALM encodes the event query with audio as context, and the grounding model combines these query representations with fine-grained audio features to localize the target event at the frame level. Extensive experiments across diverse temporal grounding benchmark

translated_title: 通过帧级定位增强大型音频-语言模型以实现细粒度时间感知
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在通用音频理解方面已取得显著进展，但在细粒度时间感知方面仍然存在局限，尤其是在精确事件定位方面。现有方法主要通过后训练LALM来预测以时间戳标记形式表示的事件边界。然而，这种生成式框架缺乏时间戳预测与细粒度声学证据之间的显式对应关系，限制了时间定位的精度和可靠性。为解决这一问题，我们用一个专门的帧级定位模型来增强LALM，同时利用其语义建模能力来表示事件查询。具体而言，冻结的LALM以音频为上下文对事件查询进行编码，定位模型则将这些查询表示与细粒度音频特征相结合，以在帧级别定位目标事件。在多样化时间定位基准上的大量实验……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用帧级定位模型增强大型音频-语言模型，利用冻结的LALM以音频为上下文编码事件查询，并将其与细粒度音频特征结合，从而实现更精确可靠的音频事件时间定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes augmenting Large Audio-Language Models with a dedicated frame-level grounding model, which encodes event queries with the frozen LALM using audio as context and combines these representations with fine-grained audio features for more precise and reliable temporal event localization.
